objs.description: Returned list of objs that satisfied input the {@link FetchSpec}.

hasMore.description:
If the {@link FetchSpec#limit} was set to less than the actual number of qualifying objs, this flag will be set to
true to indicate that there were more objs that were not returned.

queryPlans.description:
If the type being fetched from is a {@link Persistable} type and {@link FetchSpec#explain} was set to true, returns
the database query plans for all queries issued for the {@link Persistable#fetch} request.

id.description: Only used for  identifying test results for verification.  Otherwise, not used by the system at all.

error.description: Any error that may have occured during the fetch

title: Structure for return result from {@link Notification.AlertManager}.
name: App.Alert.FetchResult
